blogs.title: SEO Services Cost in Pakistan
blogs.content:
If you are comparing quotes for SEO services in Pakistan, you have probably noticed that prices are all over the place. One freelancer offers "page one rankings" for a few thousand rupees, while an agency in Lahore or Karachi quotes ten times more for what sounds like the same work. This guide explains what actually drives the cost of SEO in Pakistan, the typical price ranges you will come across, what should be included at each level, and how to tell whether a package is worth the money.

A quick note before we start: the PKR ranges below are broad, indicative market ranges based on how SEO is commonly packaged in Pakistan. They are not TechFNM's price list and they are not guarantees. The right budget for your business depends on your goals, your competition and the current state of your website, which is why any serious provider should audit your site before quoting.

What Affects the Cost of SEO Services in Pakistan?

SEO is not a single product. It is a set of ongoing activities, and the price depends on how many of those activities your website needs and how much effort each one takes. These are the main factors.

1. How competitive your keywords are

Ranking a dental clinic in Faisalabad for "dentist in Faisalabad" is a very different job from ranking an online store for "buy mobile phones in Pakistan". Highly commercial, national keywords attract big competitors with strong websites and many backlinks. The more competitive the search results, the more content, technical work and authority-building you need, and the higher the monthly cost.

2. Local, national or international targeting

A business that serves one city, such as a restaurant in Islamabad, mainly needs local SEO: a well-optimised Google Business Profile, consistent business listings, reviews and location pages. A brand that sells across Pakistan needs national SEO. A software house in Karachi that wants clients in the USA, UK or UAE is competing internationally, which usually needs more content and stronger links.

3. The size and condition of your website

A ten-page brochure website and a WooCommerce or Shopify store with 3,000 product pages need very different amounts of technical work. If your site is slow on mobile, has duplicate pages, broken links or indexing problems, those need fixing before content and link building can have full effect.

4. How much content you need

Content is often the largest ongoing cost. Service pages, location pages, product descriptions and blog articles all take research and writing time. Content written in good English (and, where relevant, Urdu) by someone who understands your industry costs more than spun or AI-generated filler, but it is the only kind that tends to rank and convert.

5. Who does the work

Freelancers, small agencies and full-service digital marketing agencies all sell SEO in Pakistan. Each model has a different cost structure, which we cover below.

Typical SEO Price Ranges in Pakistan

Most SEO in Pakistan is sold as a monthly retainer, a one-time audit, or a one-time project such as a technical clean-up. The ranges below are general indications only; actual quotes vary widely.

Type of SEO workIndicative range (PKR)Typically suits
One-time SEO auditRoughly 15,000 – 75,000 one-timeAny site that needs a clear plan before investing
Local SEO (single city)Roughly 20,000 – 60,000 per monthClinics, restaurants, salons, local service businesses
Small business SEO (national)Roughly 40,000 – 120,000 per monthService companies and small ecommerce stores
Competitive or ecommerce SEORoughly 100,000 – 300,000+ per monthLarger stores, competitive industries, multi-city brands
International SEO (USA, UK, UAE)Often quoted in USD and higher than local workExporters, software houses, agencies targeting overseas clients

If you receive a quote far below these ranges, ask exactly what is included. If you receive a quote far above them, ask what extra value justifies the difference. In both cases, the answer should be specific tasks and deliverables, not vague promises.

What Should Be Included in an SEO Package?

Whatever you pay, a professional SEO package should cover the fundamentals. Use this as a checklist when comparing proposals.

Technical SEO

  • Crawl and indexing checks in Google Search Console
  • Site speed and Core Web Vitals improvements, especially on mobile
  • Fixing broken links, redirect chains and duplicate content
  • XML sitemap, robots.txt and canonical tags set up correctly
  • Structured data (schema) for your business, services, products or articles

Keyword research and on-page SEO

  • A keyword map that assigns target keywords to specific pages
  • Optimised title tags, meta descriptions and headings
  • Internal linking between related pages
  • Image optimisation and descriptive alt text

Content

  • Improving existing service and product pages
  • New pages or articles based on what your customers actually search for
  • Location pages for each city you serve, if relevant

Local SEO

  • Google Business Profile optimisation and regular posts
  • Consistent name, address and phone number across listings
  • A simple process for asking happy customers for reviews

Off-page SEO and reporting

  • Earning relevant, good-quality backlinks rather than buying bulk links
  • A monthly report showing rankings, organic traffic and leads, with clear next steps

You can see how we approach each of these areas on our SEO services page.

Freelancer vs Agency: How the Cost Compares

Freelancers

Freelancers are usually the cheapest option and can be excellent for small, focused jobs such as a technical fix or local SEO for one location. The risks are limited capacity, gaps in skills (very few people are equally strong at technical SEO, content and outreach) and continuity if the freelancer becomes unavailable.

Specialist SEO agencies

An agency costs more but gives you a team: a strategist, technical specialist, content writers and someone handling outreach and reporting. This tends to suit businesses that need steady, multi-month work across several areas.

Full-service digital marketing agencies

A full-service agency combines SEO with web development, social media and paid ads. This can be more efficient when your website also needs redesigning or speed work, because one team owns the whole result. Learn more on our digital marketing services page.

Red Flags in Cheap SEO Packages

Low prices are not automatically bad, but some offers should make you cautious:

  • Guaranteed number one rankings. Nobody controls Google's results. Google itself warns against companies that guarantee rankings.
  • Thousands of backlinks for a fixed fee. Bulk links from spammy directories and private blog networks can lead to ranking drops.
  • No access to your own accounts. You should always own your Google Search Console, Google Analytics and Google Business Profile.
  • Reports with rankings only. Rankings for keywords nobody searches mean little. Reports should connect SEO to traffic and enquiries.
  • No audit before the quote. A provider who prices SEO without looking at your website is selling a template, not a strategy.

How to Budget for SEO in Pakistan

Start with an audit

An audit tells you what is holding your site back and what the realistic opportunities are. It turns "how much does SEO cost?" into "what will it cost to fix these specific problems and target these specific keywords?".

Commit for long enough to see results

SEO usually takes several months before you see meaningful changes, and competitive keywords can take longer. Budget for at least six months rather than judging results after four weeks.

Match the budget to the opportunity

A plumbing company in Rawalpindi does not need the same budget as a national fashion brand. Think about what a new customer is worth to you and how many extra enquiries you need each month, then choose a package that covers the work needed to get there.

Keep part of the budget for your website

Sometimes the most valuable SEO investment is a faster, better-structured website. If your site is outdated, read our guide to website development cost in Pakistan.

Examples: How Needs Differ by City and Business Type

  • A clinic in Lahore mainly needs local SEO: Google Business Profile, a service page per treatment, and reviews. A modest monthly retainer is often enough.
  • An online clothing store in Karachi needs technical SEO for hundreds of product and category pages, plus content and links to compete nationally. Expect a larger ongoing budget.
  • A software house in Islamabad targeting UK clients needs international content, case studies and authority-building links, which usually means the higher end of the range.
  • A real estate agency in Multan or Peshawar can often win locally with strong location pages and listings at a lower cost than national competitors.

Is SEO Worth the Investment?

For most businesses whose customers search on Google, yes, as long as the work is done properly. Unlike paid ads, which stop when you stop paying, well-built SEO pages can keep bringing in visitors for a long time. The key is to treat SEO as an investment with clear goals, measured in enquiries and sales, not just rankings.

Get a Free SEO Audit

Not sure what your website needs, or what a fair budget looks like for your business? TechFNM will review your site and show you the technical issues, keyword opportunities and priorities we would tackle first, with no obligation. Request your free SEO audit and we will get back to you with a clear, honest plan.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much do SEO services cost per month in Pakistan?

Monthly SEO retainers in Pakistan commonly range from around PKR 20,000 for basic local SEO to well over PKR 100,000 for competitive or ecommerce SEO. The right amount depends on your competition, website size and goals, so treat any figure as indicative until your site has been audited.

How long does SEO take to show results?

Most websites need several months of consistent work before rankings and traffic improve meaningfully. Local SEO and technical fixes can show earlier movement, while competitive national keywords usually take longer.

Is cheap SEO in Pakistan worth it?

Cheap SEO can work for small, clearly defined tasks, but packages that promise guaranteed rankings or thousands of backlinks for a low fee are risky. Always ask exactly what work will be done each month.

Should I hire a freelancer or an SEO agency?

A freelancer can suit small budgets and focused tasks. An agency suits businesses that need technical SEO, content, link building and reporting handled together by a team.

Do I need a new website before starting SEO?

Not always. Many sites can be improved through technical fixes and better content. If your website is very slow, not mobile-friendly or built on an outdated platform, rebuilding it first can make SEO more effective.

blogs.title: How to Choose the Best SEO Company in Pakistan
blogs.content:
Choosing the right SEO company in Pakistan can be the difference between a website that brings in steady enquiries and one that quietly burns your marketing budget. There are hundreds of agencies and freelancers in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and beyond, and nearly all of them promise first-page rankings. This guide gives you a practical, step-by-step way to compare them, the questions to ask before you sign, and the warning signs that tell you to walk away.

Why Choosing the Right SEO Company in Pakistan Matters

SEO is a long-term investment. You will usually work with a provider for six months or more, and the decisions they make affect your website for years. Good SEO builds an asset: pages that rank, a healthy technical foundation, and a brand that Google trusts. Poor SEO can do the opposite. Spammy backlinks, thin content and careless site changes can cause ranking drops that take months to recover from.

Price matters, but the bigger question is whether the company understands your business, your customers and how they search. A provider that ranks you for keywords nobody uses has not helped you, however good the report looks.

Step 1: Define What You Need Before You Shortlist

Before you contact any agency, write down three things:

  • Your goal. More phone calls? Online sales? Leads from abroad? "Rank higher" is not a goal; "get more enquiries for our services in Lahore" is.
  • Your market. One city, the whole of Pakistan, or international markets such as the USA, UK or UAE.
  • Your budget and timeframe. Be realistic. Our guide to SEO services cost in Pakistan explains typical ranges.

This makes it much easier to tell which companies are a good fit, and it gives every agency the same brief so you can compare proposals fairly.

Step 2: Check Their Own Visibility and Experience

Do they practise what they preach?

Search for terms like "SEO company in [their city]" and see whether they appear. An SEO company does not have to rank number one for its own name in every city, but if its website is slow, thin or full of errors, that tells you something about its standards.

Look for relevant examples

Ask for examples of work in your industry or a similar one. A company that has helped local service businesses may not be the best fit for a large ecommerce store, and vice versa. Real examples should be verifiable: a live website you can look at, a client you can speak to, or Google reviews from real customers.

Read reviews carefully

Google reviews, Clutch profiles and LinkedIn recommendations are useful, but read the content of the reviews, not just the star rating. Specific comments about communication, transparency and results are worth more than generic praise.

Step 3: Understand Their Process

A professional SEO company should be able to explain, in plain language, what it will do in the first three months. A typical process looks like this:

  1. Audit. A technical, content and backlink review of your site.
  2. Keyword research. Finding the searches your customers actually make, with search intent mapped to specific pages.
  3. Technical fixes. Speed, mobile usability, indexing, redirects and structured data.
  4. On-page optimisation. Titles, headings, internal links and content improvements.
  5. Content and local SEO. New pages, location pages, Google Business Profile work.
  6. Authority building. Earning relevant backlinks and mentions.
  7. Reporting. Monthly reports tied to traffic, leads and sales.

If an agency cannot describe its process, or describes it only as "we do on-page and off-page", ask for more detail. You can compare this with how we work on our SEO services page.

Step 4: Ask the Right Questions

These questions quickly separate experienced SEO companies from the rest:

"Will you audit my website before giving a price?"

A good company needs to see your site to estimate the work. A fixed price with no audit usually means a one-size-fits-all package.

"Which keywords will you target, and why?"

Look for an answer based on search volume, competition and buying intent, not just the keywords you suggested.

"How do you build backlinks?"

Acceptable answers include digital PR, guest content on relevant sites, local directories and partnerships. Be wary of "we have a network of sites" or "1,000 links per month".

"Who owns the accounts and content?"

You should own your Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, domain and all content created for you.

"What will the monthly report include?"

Ask to see a sample report. It should show organic traffic, conversions or leads, keyword movements and the work completed.

"What happens if we stop working together?"

You should be able to leave with everything that was built for you, without losing pages or links.

Step 5: Watch Out for These Red Flags

  • Guaranteed rankings. Google itself says no one can guarantee a number one ranking.
  • Secret methods. Good SEO is not secret. If a company will not explain what it does, assume the worst.
  • Very cheap packages with huge deliverables. "100 backlinks and 20 articles for a few thousand rupees" cannot be good quality.
  • Long lock-in contracts. A commitment of several months is normal for SEO; a year-long contract with no exit clause is not.
  • No questions about your business. An agency that does not ask about your customers, margins and services cannot build a strategy around them.

Step 6: Compare Proposals Side by Side

Once you have two or three proposals, put them in a simple comparison table:

What to compareWhat good looks like
Audit findingsSpecific issues on your site, not generic advice
Keyword planKeywords mapped to pages, with intent explained
Monthly deliverablesClear tasks, content volume and link-building approach
ReportingTraffic, leads and rankings, with next steps
Contract termsReasonable minimum term, clear exit, you own everything
CommunicationA named contact and a regular meeting or update

The cheapest proposal is rarely the best value, and the most expensive is not automatically the best. Choose the one that best matches your goals and explains its plan most clearly.

Local Agency or Remote Provider?

Many businesses prefer an SEO company in their own city. A Lahore restaurant group may value face-to-face meetings, and a Karachi retailer may want an agency that understands its local market. That said, SEO is mostly done online, and a remote team can serve you well if communication is good. What matters most is local knowledge of your market and customers, not the agency's postcode. If you are specifically looking in Lahore, see our guide to the best SEO agency in Lahore.

SEO as Part of a Wider Digital Strategy

SEO works best alongside a fast website, useful content and well-run social media and paid campaigns. If your website needs work, or you want SEO and ads managed together, a full-service team can coordinate everything. See our digital marketing services for how we combine channels.

What a Good First 90 Days Looks Like

It helps to know what to expect once you sign, so you can tell early whether the relationship is on track.

Month one: foundations

The company completes its audit, agrees the keyword map with you, sets up or checks Google Search Console and Analytics, and starts fixing the most serious technical issues. You should receive a written plan for the next two months.

Month two: on-page and content

Titles, headings and internal links are improved on priority pages, thin pages are expanded or merged, and the first new content goes live. For local businesses, the Google Business Profile and key citations should be fully optimised by now.

Month three: authority and review

Link-building and outreach begin to produce results, and the first full report compares traffic, impressions and enquiries with the starting point. Expect an honest discussion of what is working, what is not, and what changes next.

If you reach the end of the third month without a clear plan, visible completed work and a report you understand, raise it directly. A good SEO company in Pakistan will welcome the conversation.

Get a Free SEO Audit Before You Decide

The best way to judge any SEO company is to see how it thinks about your website. TechFNM offers a free SEO audit that highlights your biggest technical issues, content gaps and keyword opportunities, so you can make an informed choice, whether you work with us or not. Request your free SEO audit today.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I know if an SEO company in Pakistan is legitimate?

Check that it has a professional website, real client examples, genuine reviews and a clear process. Legitimate companies explain what they will do, give you access to your own data and never guarantee specific rankings.

What should an SEO company deliver in the first month?

Usually an audit, keyword research, a strategy, access set-up for Search Console and Analytics, and the first technical fixes. Visible ranking changes typically come later.

Should I choose an SEO company in my own city?

It can help with meetings and local market knowledge, but it is not essential. Communication, transparency and relevant experience matter more than location.

How long should I work with an SEO company before judging results?

Give a new provider at least four to six months of consistent work, while checking monthly that the agreed tasks are being completed and that traffic and enquiries are trending in the right direction.

Can I do SEO myself instead of hiring a company?

Yes, many small businesses handle basic SEO themselves, especially local SEO. Hiring a company makes sense when you lack time, need technical expertise or are competing in a crowded market.

blogs.title: Local SEO Guide for Small Businesses
blogs.content:
When someone in your city searches "near me" or types a service plus a location, Google shows a map with three businesses and then a list of websites. Getting into that map pack is often the fastest way for a small business to win new customers from search. This guide explains how local SEO services work, what you can do yourself, and when it makes sense to get professional help. The examples focus on Pakistan, but the principles apply to any local business.

What Are Local SEO Services?

Local SEO is the process of making your business visible in search results for a specific area. It covers your Google Business Profile, your website's location signals, your listings on other sites and your customer reviews. Local SEO services are the work an agency or specialist does to improve all of these, so that people nearby find you before your competitors.

Local SEO matters most for businesses that serve customers in a defined area: clinics, restaurants, salons, gyms, schools, law firms, property agents, repair services, showrooms and similar. If your customers come to you, or you go to them within a city, local SEO should be a priority.

How Google Decides Local Rankings

Google has said that local results are based mainly on three factors:

  • Relevance: how well your business profile and website match what the person searched for.
  • Distance: how far your business is from the searcher, or from the location in their search.
  • Prominence: how well known your business is, including reviews, links, mentions and your overall web presence.

You cannot change distance, but you can strongly influence relevance and prominence. Everything below is designed to do exactly that.

Step 1: Set Up and Optimise Your Google Business Profile

Your Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) is the single most important local SEO asset. It is free, and it controls how you appear in Google Maps and the local pack.

Claim and verify your profile

Search for your business on Google Maps. If a profile exists, claim it; if not, create one. Verification may be by postcard, phone, email or video depending on your business.

Complete every field

  • Use your real business name, without stuffing keywords into it.
  • Choose the most accurate primary category, then add relevant secondary categories.
  • Add your full address (or service area), phone number, website and opening hours, including holiday hours such as Eid.
  • Write a clear business description that mentions your main services and the areas you serve.
  • List your services and, where relevant, products with short descriptions.

Add photos and keep it active

Upload real photos of your premises, team and work. Publish updates and offers regularly, and answer questions in the Q&A section. An active, complete profile gives customers more reasons to choose you.

Step 2: Make Your Website Locally Relevant

Put your NAP on every page

NAP stands for name, address and phone number. Show it consistently in your website footer and on your contact page, in exactly the same format as your Google Business Profile.

Create a page for each main service

A single "Services" page cannot rank for everything. A clinic in Lahore should have separate pages for each treatment it offers, each explaining the service, the process, the location and how to book.

Create location pages if you serve several areas

If you operate in more than one city, for example Karachi and Hyderabad, create a genuinely useful page for each location with the address, map, local contact details and information specific to that branch. Avoid copying the same text with only the city name changed.

Add local business schema

Structured data (LocalBusiness schema) helps search engines understand your name, address, hours and contact details. It is a small technical step that a developer or SEO provider can add quickly.

Make it fast and mobile-friendly

Most local searches happen on phones. A slow website loses visitors before they call. If your site needs a rebuild, our web development services focus on speed and mobile usability.

Step 3: Build Consistent Local Citations

Citations are mentions of your business name, address and phone number on other websites, such as business directories, industry listings, maps apps and social profiles. Consistent citations help Google trust that your information is correct.

  • List your business on major platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Apple Maps and Bing Places.
  • Add it to reputable Pakistani and industry-specific directories that real customers use.
  • Use exactly the same name, address and phone number everywhere.
  • Fix old listings with outdated phone numbers or addresses.

Step 4: Earn and Manage Reviews

Reviews influence both rankings and whether people choose you. The key is a simple, honest system.

Ask every happy customer

Send a short WhatsApp message or SMS with a direct link to your review form after a successful job or visit. Most satisfied customers are happy to help if you make it easy.

Reply to every review

Thank people for positive reviews and respond calmly and professionally to negative ones. Future customers read your replies.

Never buy or fake reviews

Fake reviews break Google's policies and can lead to reviews being removed or your profile being restricted. Real reviews from real customers are the only safe approach.

Step 5: Create Local Content and Links

Content that answers local questions helps you rank for more searches and earns links naturally. A property agent in Islamabad could write guides to different sectors; a restaurant in Karachi could publish its catering menu and event information. Local links from chambers of commerce, sponsorships, community events, suppliers and local news sites all add prominence.

Step 6: Track What Matters

  • Google Business Profile insights: calls, direction requests, website clicks and searches.
  • Google Search Console: which local searches show your website and how often people click.
  • Google Analytics: visits and enquiries from organic search.
  • Calls and WhatsApp enquiries: ask new customers how they found you.

Common Local SEO Mistakes

  • Different phone numbers or addresses on different platforms
  • Adding keywords to the business name on Google
  • Choosing the wrong primary category
  • Ignoring reviews or responding defensively
  • Copying the same location page text for multiple cities
  • A website with no clear address, phone number or call button on mobile

DIY or Professional Local SEO Services?

Many small businesses can handle the basics themselves: claiming the profile, adding photos and asking for reviews. Professional local SEO services make sense when you operate in a competitive area, have multiple locations, need technical website work, or simply do not have the time. A provider should handle profile optimisation, citations, on-site changes, schema, content and reporting. See how we handle local and organic search on our SEO services page, and read how to choose the best SEO company in Pakistan before you hire anyone.

A Simple Monthly Local SEO Routine

Local SEO is not a one-time task. A short monthly routine keeps your visibility growing:

  1. Week one: publish two or three Google Business Profile updates, such as offers, new services or recent work, with real photos.
  2. Week two: send review requests to recent customers and reply to every new review.
  3. Week three: check your listings for incorrect details and update opening hours for upcoming holidays.
  4. Week four: review calls, direction requests and website clicks in your profile insights, and note which searches brought people to you.

For example, a salon in Johar Town, Lahore could post a new bridal package, share before-and-after photos (with permission), ask last month's clients for reviews and check that its WhatsApp number is correct everywhere. A few hours a month is often enough to stay ahead of competitors who set up their profile once and forgot about it.

Local SEO for Multi-Location Businesses

If you run branches in more than one city, such as a pharmacy chain in Karachi and Hyderabad or a restaurant brand in Lahore and Islamabad, each branch needs its own verified Google Business Profile, its own location page on your website and its own reviews. Use a consistent naming format, keep each branch's phone number and hours accurate, and make sure every location page has unique, helpful details such as nearby landmarks, parking and branch-specific services.

blogs.title: Digital Marketing Agency in Lahore: What to Look For
blogs.content:
Lahore has one of the busiest business scenes in Pakistan, from Gulberg's restaurants and DHA's boutiques to textile exporters, software houses and fast-growing ecommerce brands. That also means a crowded market of marketing providers. If you are looking for a digital marketing agency in Lahore, this guide explains what services you should expect, how to judge an agency's skills, what questions to ask, and how to avoid the most common hiring mistakes.

Why Lahore Businesses Need a Strong Digital Presence

Customers in Lahore increasingly discover businesses on Google, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube before they visit or call. A restaurant in MM Alam Road, a clinic in Johar Town or a furniture showroom on Ferozepur Road all compete for attention on the same small phone screen. A good digital marketing partner helps you show up in the right places, with the right message, and turns that attention into calls, bookings and sales.

Lahore is also a base for many exporters and IT companies that sell to clients in the USA, UK and UAE. For them, digital marketing is about credibility and lead generation in international markets, not just local footfall.

Services a Digital Marketing Agency in Lahore Should Offer

Not every business needs every service, but a capable agency should be able to advise on the full mix and deliver the parts you need.

Search engine optimisation (SEO)

Technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimisation, content and link building to bring in free, consistent traffic from Google. For local businesses, this includes Google Business Profile optimisation and local SEO. See our SEO services for what this involves.

Paid advertising

Google Ads (search, display, shopping and YouTube) and Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram), plus TikTok ads where relevant. Paid campaigns can bring results quickly, but they need careful targeting, tracking and ongoing optimisation to avoid wasted spend.

Social media marketing

Content planning, design, video, community management and paid social. For many consumer brands in Lahore, Instagram and TikTok are now the main shop window. Our social media marketing services cover strategy through to execution.

Website design and development

Your website is where most digital campaigns end up. A fast, mobile-friendly site with clear calls to action makes every other channel more effective.

Content and branding

Blog articles, landing pages, product descriptions, brand guidelines and creative assets that keep your message consistent across channels.

Analytics and reporting

Proper tracking of calls, form submissions, WhatsApp clicks and sales, so you can see which channels actually drive revenue.

What to Look For When Choosing an Agency

1. Clear strategy, not just activity

Posting three times a week or running a boosted post is activity. Strategy means knowing who your customers are, which channels they use, what message will persuade them and how success will be measured. Ask each agency how it would approach your first 90 days.

2. Relevant experience

Ask for examples in your industry or a similar one. Marketing a restaurant, a B2B textile exporter and an online clothing brand all require different approaches. Verify examples by looking at the live websites, ads or social accounts.

3. In-house skills

Find out who will actually do the work. Does the agency have its own designers, content writers, SEO specialists and ad managers, or does it outsource most tasks? Outsourcing is not always bad, but you should know who is responsible.

4. Transparent reporting

You should receive regular reports that connect spend and effort to results: leads, sales, cost per lead and return on ad spend, not only likes and impressions. Ask to see a sample report.

5. Ownership of your accounts

Your ad accounts, Google Analytics, Search Console, social pages and website should be in your business's name, with the agency given access. Never let an agency own your core assets.

6. Communication and fit

Agree how often you will meet, who your main contact is and how quickly they respond. A good relationship depends on clear, regular communication.

Questions to Ask Before You Hire

  • What would you focus on first for a business like ours, and why?
  • Which channels do you think we should not invest in yet?
  • How do you track leads from calls and WhatsApp, not just website forms?
  • What is included in your monthly fee, and what costs extra (ad spend, video shoots, tools)?
  • What is the minimum contract length and how can we end the agreement?
  • Can we speak to one or two of your current clients?

Understanding Budgets in Lahore

Digital marketing fees in Lahore vary widely depending on the services, the size of the agency and the amount of content required. As a general guide, small social media or SEO retainers often start in the tens of thousands of rupees per month, while multi-channel campaigns with video production and paid ads management cost considerably more. Remember that ad spend paid to Google or Meta is usually separate from the agency fee. For SEO-specific pricing, read our guide to SEO services cost in Pakistan.

Rather than starting with the cheapest option, decide what results you need and ask each agency to explain the budget required to achieve them.

Red Flags to Avoid

  • Guaranteed results: no one can guarantee rankings, viral posts or a fixed number of sales.
  • Vanity metrics only: follower counts and likes without any link to enquiries or revenue.
  • Bought followers or fake engagement: these damage your reach and credibility.
  • No questions about your business: a proposal that could be sent to any company is a template, not a plan.
  • Hidden costs: unclear fees for design, tools or ad management.

Examples of How Needs Differ in Lahore

  • A restaurant in Gulberg may focus on Instagram and TikTok content, Google Business Profile, reviews and local food delivery platforms.
  • A clinic in DHA usually benefits most from local SEO, Google search ads for specific treatments and a fast website with online booking.
  • An ecommerce clothing brand needs Meta and TikTok ads, product SEO, email or WhatsApp marketing and strong conversion tracking.
  • A software house exporting services needs international SEO, LinkedIn content, case studies and a professional website aimed at overseas buyers.

Local Agency or Remote Partner?

Meeting your agency in person can make collaboration easier, especially for photo and video shoots. However, many Lahore businesses work successfully with agencies based in Karachi, Islamabad or abroad. Focus on expertise, communication and transparency first. If you are also considering providers in Karachi, see our guide to choosing a digital marketing agency in Karachi.

How TechFNM Works With Businesses

TechFNM is a digital marketing agency in Pakistan offering SEO, paid ads, social media, web development and content. We start every engagement with an audit and a clear plan, give you ownership of all your accounts, and report on the metrics that matter to your business. Explore our digital marketing services to see how we work.

How to Run a Fair Trial With a New Agency

If you are unsure about committing long term, ask whether the agency will agree a defined first phase, for example a three-month engagement with clear deliverables and success measures agreed in writing. During this period:

  • Agree the two or three metrics that matter most, such as qualified enquiries, cost per lead or online sales.
  • Record your starting numbers before the agency begins, so progress can be measured honestly.
  • Hold a short fortnightly check-in to review work completed and early signals.
  • At the end of the phase, review results together and decide whether to continue, adjust or stop.

This protects both sides. You avoid being locked into a long contract with the wrong partner, and the agency has a fair chance to show what it can do. Keep in mind that SEO usually needs longer than three months to show its full effect, so judge it on progress and completed work rather than final rankings.

Preparing Your Business Before You Hire

An agency can only work with what you give it. Before your first meeting, gather your website and social media logins, any past campaign results, your best-selling products or services, typical customer questions and your current monthly sales or enquiry numbers. Decide who in your team will approve content and respond to leads. Lahore businesses that prepare this information get faster, more accurate proposals and see results sooner.

Before you commit to any agency, find out where your website stands. We will review your site's technical health, content and search visibility and give you a practical action plan. Request your free SEO audit.

It plans and runs your online marketing, which can include SEO, Google and Meta ads, social media management, content, website development and analytics, with the aim of generating leads and sales.

Fees vary widely by scope. Smaller single-channel retainers often start in the tens of thousands of rupees per month, while multi-channel campaigns cost more. Ad spend is usually paid separately.

Which digital marketing channel is best for a Lahore business?

It depends on your customers. Local service businesses often benefit most from local SEO and Google search ads, while consumer brands usually see strong results from Instagram, TikTok and Meta ads.

How long before I see results from digital marketing?

Paid ads can generate enquiries within days of launch, while SEO and organic social media usually take several months to build momentum.

Do I need a Lahore-based agency to market my Lahore business?

Not necessarily. Local knowledge helps, but strategy, communication and proven results are more important than the agency's address.

blogs.content:
Searching for the best SEO agency in Lahore usually produces a long list of companies that all claim to be number one. The truth is that the "best" agency is the one that fits your business, your budget and your goals, and that can show a clear, honest plan to improve your search visibility. This guide gives Lahore business owners a practical framework to evaluate SEO agencies, understand what good SEO work looks like, and choose with confidence.

What Makes an SEO Agency in Lahore the "Best" Choice?

There is no official ranking of SEO agencies, and lists that claim to name the "top 10" are often paid placements or written by the agencies themselves. A better approach is to judge each agency against criteria that actually predict success:

  • Understanding of your market. Do they know how customers in Lahore (or your export markets) search for what you sell?
  • Technical skill. Can they diagnose and fix speed, indexing and site-structure problems?
  • Content quality. Can they write pages that answer real questions, in clear English or Urdu as needed?
  • Ethical link building. Do they earn links in ways that will not put your site at risk?
  • Transparency. Do they explain their work and report on results that matter to your business?

The Lahore Search Landscape

Lahore searches are highly local. People search for "best dentist in DHA Lahore", "wedding photographer Lahore" or "plumber near me" and expect results within a short drive. At the same time, Lahore is home to many exporters, IT firms and ecommerce stores competing nationally or internationally. A good SEO agency recognises which of these situations you are in and plans accordingly.

Local-first businesses

Clinics, restaurants, salons, schools, gyms, real estate agents and home-service companies typically need strong local SEO: an optimised Google Business Profile, location-specific service pages, consistent listings and a steady flow of genuine reviews. Our local SEO guide for small businesses explains these steps in detail.

National ecommerce brands

Fashion, home decor and electronics stores based in Lahore compete across Pakistan. They need technical SEO for large product catalogues, optimised category pages and content that targets buying-intent searches.

Exporters and B2B companies

Textile, sports goods, surgical instrument and software companies often target buyers in the USA, UK and Europe. They need international SEO, credible content and authority-building links.

Evaluating an SEO Agency: A Practical Checklist

Review their audit

Ask for an audit or initial review of your site before committing. A useful audit names specific problems on your website, such as slow pages, missing titles, duplicate content or indexing errors, and ranks them by impact. A generic PDF that could apply to any site is a warning sign.

Ask about keyword strategy

The agency should explain which keywords it would target, why, and which page on your site would rank for each one. It should prioritise keywords with commercial intent, such as "SEO services in Lahore" for an agency or "bridal makeup Lahore price" for a salon, rather than broad terms with little chance of converting.

Understand their link-building approach

Acceptable methods include digital PR, guest articles on relevant websites, local partnerships, sponsorships and quality directories. Avoid agencies that sell links by the hundred, use private blog networks or cannot explain where links will come from.

Check their reporting

Ask for a sample monthly report. It should show organic traffic, leads or sales from organic search, keyword movements, and the work completed that month, with plans for the next.

Confirm contract terms

SEO typically needs a commitment of several months, but you should understand the minimum term, notice period and what happens to content and accounts if you leave. You should always own your website, content, Google Search Console and Analytics.

Questions to Ask Every Lahore SEO Agency

  1. What are the three biggest SEO problems on our website right now?
  2. Which keywords would you prioritise in the first three months?
  3. How will you build authority for our site?
  4. Who will work on our account, and what are their roles?
  5. How will you measure leads and sales, not just rankings?
  6. What do you need from us to succeed?

Warning Signs

  • "Guaranteed first page in 30 days." Rankings depend on Google and your competitors. Nobody can guarantee them.
  • Prices that seem too good to be true. Quality content and technical work take time. Very low prices usually mean shortcuts.
  • Reluctance to share details. If an agency will not say what it is doing, you cannot judge its work.
  • Focus on vanity keywords. Ranking for your own brand name or obscure phrases does not grow your business.
  • No interest in your conversions. Traffic that does not turn into enquiries is not success.

What Does SEO Cost in Lahore?

SEO pricing in Lahore follows the wider Pakistani market. Local SEO for a single location commonly starts in the region of PKR 20,000 to 60,000 per month, while national ecommerce and competitive campaigns can cost well over PKR 100,000 per month. These are broad indications, not fixed prices. Our detailed guide to SEO services cost in Pakistan breaks this down further.

Should You Choose an Agency Based in Lahore?

A Lahore-based agency can offer face-to-face meetings and familiarity with local neighbourhoods and competitors. That is valuable, but not essential. SEO is delivered online, and the most important factors are expertise, communication and honesty. TechFNM works with clients across Pakistan, including Lahore, as well as businesses in the USA, UK and UAE. For a broader view of how to evaluate providers, read how to choose the best SEO company in Pakistan.

SEO Works Best With a Strong Website

Many Lahore businesses discover that their website itself is the biggest obstacle: slow loading on mobile, outdated design or a structure that hides key services. In those cases, improving or rebuilding the site can unlock SEO progress. Our web development services are built with SEO foundations from day one.

Our Approach at TechFNM

We begin with a full audit, agree clear goals, and then work through technical fixes, on-page optimisation, content and ethical link building, with monthly reporting tied to leads. You keep ownership of everything we create. Learn more about our SEO services.

Comparing Agencies Side by Side

Once you have spoken to two or three agencies, a simple scorecard keeps the decision objective. Score each agency from one to five on:

CriteriaWhat to look for
Quality of auditSpecific, prioritised issues on your own website
Keyword planCommercial keywords mapped to pages, including Lahore-specific searches
Technical abilityClear answers about speed, indexing and site structure
Content approachOriginal, helpful content written for your customers
Link buildingEthical, explainable methods
ReportingTraffic, leads and completed work, not just rankings
CommunicationNamed contact, regular updates, quick responses
Contract termsReasonable minimum term and full ownership of your assets

Add up the scores, but also trust your judgement about which team understood your business best. The agency that asks the sharpest questions about your customers is often the one that will deliver the best results.

Lahore-Specific SEO Opportunities

Lahore searches often include neighbourhood names, such as DHA, Gulberg, Johar Town, Bahria Town, Model Town and Wapda Town. If you serve several areas, a good agency will consider useful area pages, accurate service-area settings in your Google Business Profile and content that reflects how customers in each part of the city search. Seasonal demand also matters: wedding season, Ramadan, Eid and back-to-school periods can change what people search for, and your content calendar should plan for them.

Language is another opportunity. Many Lahore customers search in English, but some search in Urdu or Roman Urdu, especially for local services. A thoughtful SEO agency in Lahore will check how your customers actually phrase their searches before deciding which language each page should target.

Signs Your SEO Is Working

Rankings take time, so watch for earlier signals: more pages indexed in Google Search Console, rising impressions for your target keywords, more clicks from Lahore searches, and more calls or direction requests from your Google Business Profile. Steady improvement in these numbers usually comes before the bigger jumps in traffic and enquiries.

SEO and local SEO

Agree on ownership

Examples: Matching Strategy to Business Type in Karachi

  • A restaurant in Clifton or Boat Basin: Instagram and TikTok content, Google Business Profile, reviews and food delivery platform optimisation.
  • A home-services company covering Gulshan, DHA and North Nazimabad: Google search ads with area targeting, local SEO and fast WhatsApp follow-up.
  • An online store shipping nationwide: Meta and TikTok ads, product SEO, abandoned-cart follow-up and strong analytics.
  • A logistics or manufacturing company selling B2B: LinkedIn, SEO for industry terms, a credible website and case studies.

Red Flags When Hiring an Agency

  • Guaranteed sales figures, rankings or follower counts
  • Reports focused only on reach and likes
  • Buying followers, likes or reviews
  • Unclear pricing or surprise charges
  • Refusal to share account access or data
  • Long contracts with no performance reviews

Working With an Agency Outside Karachi

Some Karachi businesses prefer an agency nearby for in-person meetings and shoots, while others work with teams in Lahore, Islamabad or abroad. Location matters less than expertise, responsiveness and transparency. If you are comparing options in other cities, see our guide to finding a digital marketing agency in Lahore.

Why Businesses Work With TechFNM

TechFNM is a digital marketing agency in Pakistan, based in Karachi, offering SEO, Google Ads, social media, web and app development, ecommerce and content writing for clients in Pakistan, the USA, the UK and the UAE. We start with an audit, agree measurable goals, keep you in ownership of your accounts, and report on the numbers that matter. Explore our digital marketing services.

Building a Simple Karachi Marketing Plan

Whether you hire an agency or not, it helps to have a basic plan before you spend money. A simple version looks like this:

1. Define your customer

Who buys from you, which parts of Karachi they live or work in, what they search for and which platforms they use. A bakery in Bahadurabad and a B2B packaging supplier in SITE Area have very different customers.

2. Pick your priority channels

Choose two or three channels that match your customers, for example local SEO and Google search ads for a service business, or Instagram, TikTok and Meta ads for a consumer brand.

3. Set a realistic budget and timeline

Separate the agency fee from ad spend, and give each channel enough time to show results. Paid ads can be judged within weeks; SEO needs months.

4. Prepare your website and follow-up

Make sure your website loads quickly on mobile, your phone and WhatsApp numbers work, and someone is ready to respond to enquiries quickly. Slow follow-up wastes marketing spend.

5. Measure and adjust

Track enquiries and sales by channel every month, then move budget toward what is working. A good digital marketing agency in Karachi should lead this process and explain every recommendation.

Karachi's traffic, size and diversity mean that location targeting matters. Campaigns can be focused on specific areas, such as Clifton and DHA, or Gulshan-e-Iqbal and Gulistan-e-Jauhar, so you only pay to reach customers you can actually serve. Language matters too: testing English, Urdu and Roman Urdu ad copy often reveals clear differences in response.

Common Mistakes Karachi Businesses Make

  • Boosting posts without a goal: spending on reach without knowing whether it brings customers.
  • Targeting the whole city: paying to reach areas you cannot serve or deliver to.
  • Slow responses: leaving WhatsApp and Instagram messages unanswered for hours, while competitors reply in minutes.
  • Ignoring Google Business Profile: missing out on free visibility in Google Maps.
  • Changing agencies too often: SEO and brand-building need consistent effort to pay off.

Avoiding these mistakes often improves results more than increasing your budget.

A good agency will spot these issues in its first review of your accounts and fix the basics before recommending new spend.

Typically SEO, local SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing and advertising, website development, content creation, video, and analytics and reporting.

How much does digital marketing cost in Karachi?

It depends on scope. Single-channel retainers often start in the tens of thousands of rupees per month, with integrated campaigns costing more. Ad spend is usually separate from agency fees.

Which is better for a Karachi business: SEO or paid ads?

They work best together. Paid ads deliver quick results, while SEO builds long-term, lower-cost traffic. Many businesses start with ads and invest in SEO at the same time.

Paid campaigns can produce enquiries within days. SEO and organic social media typically take several months to show consistent growth.

blogs.title: Social Media Marketing Agency in Pakistan
blogs.content:
Pakistani customers spend a large part of their online time on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and WhatsApp. For many brands, social media is now where customers first discover them, compare options and decide to buy. Hiring a social media marketing agency in Pakistan can help you turn that attention into real business, but only if you choose a partner that understands strategy, content and measurement. This guide explains what a good agency does, what it costs, and how to choose the right one.

What Does a Social Media Marketing Agency in Pakistan Do?

A social media marketing agency plans, creates, publishes and promotes content for your brand across social platforms, and measures the results. A full-service agency typically handles:

  • Strategy: defining your audience, goals, platforms, tone of voice and content themes.
  • Content creation: graphics, carousels, short-form video, reels, stories and captions in English and Urdu.
  • Publishing and community management: scheduling posts, replying to comments and messages, and handling customer queries.
  • Paid social advertising: running and optimising ads on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.
  • Influencer collaborations: finding suitable creators and managing campaigns.
  • Reporting: tracking reach, engagement, leads, sales and cost per result.

You can see how we structure this work on our social media marketing services page.

Choosing the Right Platforms for Pakistani Audiences

Facebook

Still one of the widest-reaching platforms in Pakistan, especially for audiences outside the biggest cities and for older age groups. Facebook ads remain powerful for lead generation and ecommerce.

Instagram

Essential for fashion, beauty, food, lifestyle, home decor and many service businesses in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad. Reels and stories drive discovery, while a well-organised profile builds trust.

TikTok

Very popular with younger audiences across Pakistan. Short, authentic videos can reach large audiences quickly, and TikTok ads offer an additional paid channel.

YouTube

Ideal for longer explanations, reviews, tutorials and brand storytelling. YouTube content also appears in Google search results.

LinkedIn

The best fit for B2B companies, software houses, exporters and professional services targeting decision-makers in Pakistan and abroad.

WhatsApp

Not a traditional social network, but central to how Pakistani customers enquire and order. A good agency connects social campaigns to WhatsApp so leads are captured and followed up quickly.

What to Look For in a Social Media Agency

A strategy tied to business goals

Ask what the agency would aim to achieve in the first three months and how it would measure success. "More followers" is rarely the right goal; enquiries, sales, bookings or app installs usually are.

Strong creative quality

Look at the agency's own social profiles and the accounts it manages. Is the content original, on-brand and well produced? Do videos feel native to each platform, or are the same designs simply reposted everywhere?

Paid advertising expertise

Organic reach is limited on most platforms, so paid social is usually part of the plan. Ask how the agency structures campaigns, tests creative, targets audiences and tracks conversions using tools such as the Meta Pixel and Conversions API.

Honest metrics

A good agency will never buy followers, likes or comments. Fake engagement can harm your reach and makes your data meaningless. Reports should show real results and explain what will change next month.

Responsiveness

Social media moves quickly. Agree response times for comments and messages, and who handles customer queries out of hours or during busy periods such as Ramadan, Eid sales and 11.11.

How Much Does Social Media Marketing Cost in Pakistan?

Pricing depends on the number of platforms, the volume and type of content, and whether paid ads and video production are included. As a broad, indicative guide:

ScopeIndicative range (PKR per month)
Basic management of one or two platforms with designed postsRoughly 25,000 – 60,000
Multi-platform management with reels or short videosRoughly 60,000 – 150,000
Full-service social with video production and paid ads managementRoughly 150,000 and above

These ranges are general market indications, not fixed prices, and advertising spend paid to the platforms is normally separate. Always ask exactly how many posts, videos and ad campaigns are included.

Examples From Different Pakistani Cities and Industries

  • A clothing brand in Lahore may focus on Instagram and TikTok reels, influencer collaborations and Meta ads around seasonal launches and Eid collections.
  • A restaurant in Karachi might prioritise Instagram food content, local influencers and offers that drive dine-in and delivery orders.
  • A real estate developer in Islamabad could use Facebook and YouTube for project walkthroughs, with lead forms connected to the sales team's WhatsApp.
  • A software house in Faisalabad or Lahore targeting foreign clients would likely focus on LinkedIn content, case studies and thought leadership.

Social Media Works Best With SEO and a Strong Website

Social media creates demand; search captures it. When people see your brand on Instagram, many will later search for you on Google. A fast website and good SEO make sure they find you and convert. Learn more about our SEO services and broader digital marketing services.

Red Flags to Watch For

  • Promises of a fixed number of followers or viral content
  • Very cheap packages with large numbers of posts and no strategy
  • Copied or stock-heavy content that does not reflect your brand
  • No access to your ad account or no conversion tracking
  • Reports that only show likes and reach

Questions to Ask Before Hiring

  1. Which platforms would you prioritise for our business, and why?
  2. How many posts and videos are included each month?
  3. Who creates the content, and how are approvals handled?
  4. How will you track leads and sales from social media?
  5. What happens to our content and accounts if we stop working together?

Building a Social Media Content Calendar

Consistency matters more than volume. A good agency will build a monthly content calendar that balances different types of posts:

  • Educational content: tips, how-tos and answers to common customer questions.
  • Product or service content: features, launches, offers and demonstrations.
  • Social proof: genuine customer feedback, user-generated content and behind-the-scenes work.
  • Brand and culture: your team, values and story.
  • Seasonal content: Ramadan, Eid, Independence Day, wedding season, back-to-school and major sale events.

For example, a home decor brand in Lahore might plan two reels a week showing room makeovers, one carousel with styling tips, regular stories showing new stock, and a paid campaign around its Eid sale. Everything should point back to a clear action: visit the website, send a WhatsApp message or place an order.

Measuring Social Media Results

Engagement is useful, but it is not the final goal. Ask your agency to report on:

  • Leads, messages and orders that came from social media
  • Cost per lead or cost per purchase from paid campaigns
  • Website visits from social platforms and what those visitors did
  • Which content types and creatives performed best, and what will change next month

A social media marketing agency in Pakistan that reports on these numbers is focused on your business, not just your follower count.

In-House Team or Agency?

Some businesses hire an in-house social media executive, while others outsource to an agency. An in-house person knows your business deeply and can respond quickly, but one person rarely has strong skills in strategy, design, video, copywriting and paid ads at the same time. An agency brings a team with these skills and experience across many brands, but needs good briefing and approvals from your side.

Many growing Pakistani brands use a hybrid model: an in-house coordinator who handles customer messages, day-to-day stories and approvals, supported by an agency for strategy, creative production and paid campaigns. Whichever model you choose, make sure someone owns the results.

Before deciding, list the tasks you need covered each month and estimate the time involved. This makes the cost comparison between a salary and an agency retainer much clearer.

Get a Free SEO Audit

Your social campaigns will only be as effective as the website they send people to. TechFNM offers a free SEO audit that checks your site's speed, search visibility and conversion basics, so your social media investment is not wasted. Request your free SEO audit.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does a social media marketing agency in Pakistan do?

It plans your social strategy, creates and publishes content, manages your community, runs paid social ads and reports on results such as engagement, leads and sales.

How much does social media marketing cost in Pakistan?

Basic management of one or two platforms often starts around PKR 25,000 per month, while multi-platform work with video and ads management costs more. Ad spend is usually separate.

Which social media platform is best for my business in Pakistan?

It depends on your audience. Instagram and TikTok suit consumer and lifestyle brands, Facebook offers broad reach, YouTube suits longer content, and LinkedIn is best for B2B.

Should I boost posts or run proper ad campaigns?

Boosting is simple but limited. Structured campaigns in Meta Ads Manager give better targeting, testing and conversion tracking, and usually better results for the same budget.

How long does it take to see results from social media marketing?

Paid social can generate leads quickly, while building an engaged organic audience typically takes a few months of consistent, quality content.

blogs.title: Website Development Cost in Pakistan
blogs.content:
"How much does a website cost in Pakistan?" is one of the most common questions business owners ask, and the answers range from a few thousand rupees to several million. The difference comes down to what you actually need. This guide explains the factors that affect cost, typical price ranges for different types of websites, what to look for in a web development company in Pakistan, and how to avoid paying for a site that looks good but does not bring in business.

The PKR ranges in this article are broad, indicative market ranges, not TechFNM's price list or a quote. Exact costs depend on your requirements, which is why a good developer will discuss your goals before giving a price.

What Affects Website Development Cost in Pakistan?

1. Type of website

A five-page company profile site is very different from an online store with payment gateways, or a custom web application with user accounts and dashboards. The type of site is the biggest single cost factor.

2. Template or custom design

Pre-built templates on WordPress or Shopify are cheaper and faster. Custom designs created around your brand take more time but give a more distinctive, often better-converting result.

3. Platform and technology

WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Webflow and custom builds with frameworks such as React or Laravel all have different costs for development, hosting and maintenance.

4. Features and integrations

Booking systems, online payments (such as JazzCash, Easypaisa or card payments), delivery integrations, CRM connections, multi-language support in English and Urdu, and customer portals all add development time.

5. Content

Copywriting, product uploads, photography and video can add significantly to the budget if the developer provides them.

6. SEO and performance

A site built with SEO foundations, fast loading on mobile and correct technical setup costs more upfront than a basic build, but saves money on fixes later and performs better in search.

7. Who builds it

Freelancers, small studios and established agencies price differently, reflecting their overheads, processes and support.

Typical Website Price Ranges in Pakistan

Type of websiteIndicative range (PKR, one-time)Typical use
Basic business website (template, 5–10 pages)Roughly 30,000 – 100,000Small businesses, freelancers, startups
Custom-designed business websiteRoughly 100,000 – 300,000Established companies, clinics, schools, agencies
Ecommerce store (Shopify or WooCommerce)Roughly 80,000 – 400,000+Retail brands selling online
Custom web application or portalOften 400,000 and aboveBooking platforms, dashboards, SaaS products

Ongoing costs should also be considered: domain registration, hosting, premium plugins or apps, security, backups and maintenance. Ask for these to be listed separately in any quote.

What a Good Web Development Company in Pakistan Should Deliver

Discovery and planning

Before design starts, the company should understand your business, customers, competitors and goals, and propose a sitemap and feature list.

Mobile-first, fast design

Most visitors in Pakistan browse on smartphones, often on mobile data. Pages should load quickly and be easy to use on small screens.

SEO foundations

Clean URLs, proper headings, title tags and meta descriptions, XML sitemap, structured data, image optimisation and redirects from any old URLs. Building these in from the start is far cheaper than fixing them later. Our SEO services team works alongside development for exactly this reason.

Security and reliability

SSL certificates, secure hosting, regular updates and backups protect your site and your customers.

Easy content management

You should be able to update text, images, products and blog posts yourself without calling a developer for every change.

Training, handover and support

Expect a handover session, access to all accounts, and a clear support or maintenance option after launch.

See how we approach these stages on our web development services page.

Freelancer vs Agency: Which Is Right for You?

Freelancers are often the most affordable and can be a good fit for simple websites with a clear brief. The risks include limited availability, gaps in design or technical skills, and less formal support after launch.

Agencies cost more but provide a team covering design, development, content, SEO and project management. This suits businesses that need a more complex site, tighter deadlines or ongoing support.

Examples: Website Needs Across Pakistan

  • A clinic in Lahore needs service pages for each treatment, doctor profiles, location information, online booking and strong local SEO.
  • A fashion brand in Karachi needs a Shopify or WooCommerce store with fast product pages, local payment options, courier integration and tracking for ads.
  • A school in Islamabad needs admissions information, fee structure pages, news and events, and an easy way for parents to get in touch.
  • A manufacturer in Sialkot or Faisalabad exporting abroad needs a professional, fast international site with product catalogues, certifications and enquiry forms aimed at overseas buyers.

Hidden Costs and Red Flags

  • Developer owns the domain or hosting: always register your domain and hosting in your business's name.
  • Nulled or pirated themes and plugins: these can contain malware and receive no updates.
  • No SEO setup: a beautiful site that Google cannot crawl properly will struggle to bring in visitors.
  • No redirects when replacing an old site: changing URLs without 301 redirects can lose existing rankings.
  • Unclear scope: without a written list of pages and features, costs can grow unexpectedly.

Questions to Ask Before You Hire

  1. Can you show live websites you have built that are similar to what we need?
  2. Which platform do you recommend for us, and why?
  3. What exactly is included in the price, and what are the ongoing costs?
  4. Will the site be built with SEO and speed best practices from day one?
  5. Will we own the domain, hosting, design files and all accounts?
  6. What support do you offer after launch?

Your Website Is a Marketing Asset

A website should not just look good; it should bring in enquiries and sales. That means pairing development with SEO, clear messaging and campaigns that send the right visitors. If you are also budgeting for search, read our guide to SEO services cost in Pakistan, or explore our digital marketing services.

How to Prepare Before Requesting Quotes

You will get more accurate and comparable quotes if you prepare a short brief before contacting developers. Include:

  • Your goals: more enquiries, online sales, bookings or credibility with overseas buyers.
  • A list of pages: for example Home, About, each service, Contact, Blog and any location pages.
  • Required features: online payments, booking, product filters, multilingual content, WhatsApp chat, CRM integration.
  • Examples you like: two or three websites (from any industry) and what you like about them.
  • Content readiness: whether you will provide text and photos, or need them created.
  • Budget range and deadline: even a rough range helps developers recommend the right approach.

Send the same brief to every company you contact. This makes it easy to compare what each one includes, and it shows you which developers ask thoughtful follow-up questions.

Redesigning an Existing Website

If you already have a website that ranks for some searches, be careful when replacing it. Ask your developer to keep or redirect every important URL with 301 redirects, carry over title tags and content that already performs well, and test the new site in Google Search Console after launch. Skipping these steps is one of the most common reasons businesses lose traffic after a redesign.

Maintenance: The Cost Most People Forget

A website is not finished at launch. Plugins, themes and platforms need regular updates, backups must be checked, security monitored and content refreshed. Many web development companies in Pakistan offer monthly or annual maintenance plans, or charge by the hour for changes. Ask what is included, how quickly urgent issues are fixed, and who to contact if the site goes down. Budgeting for maintenance from the start keeps your website fast, secure and effective.

Get a Free SEO Audit

Already have a website? Before you rebuild it, find out what is holding it back. TechFNM will audit your current site's speed, technical SEO and content, and tell you whether it needs fixes or a full rebuild. Request your free SEO audit.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a website cost in Pakistan?

A basic template-based business website often costs roughly PKR 30,000 to 100,000, custom-designed business sites more, and ecommerce stores or web applications considerably more depending on features.

How long does it take to build a website?

A simple business website can take a few weeks, while custom designs, ecommerce stores and web applications usually take one to several months depending on scope and content readiness.

Is WordPress or Shopify better for my business?

WordPress is flexible and suits content-heavy business websites and many stores via WooCommerce. Shopify is often simpler for dedicated ecommerce brands. The right choice depends on your products, budget and team.

What ongoing costs should I expect after launch?

Domain renewal, hosting, premium plugins or apps, security, backups and maintenance. Ask your web development company to list these clearly.

How do I choose a web development company in Pakistan?

Review live work, check reviews, compare detailed proposals, confirm you will own all accounts, and make sure SEO, speed and support are included.
